angularDiameterSource: Stellar radius 0.523 (+0.023/−0.021) solar radii from Torres et al. 2015, ApJ 800, 99 (2015). It is a radius from stellar characterisation, not an interferometric diameter; the angular diameter in the record is that radius at the Gaia distance.
distanceSource: Gaia EDR3 parallax 5.6336 +/- 0.0169 mas via SIMBAD (2020yCat.1350....0G): 177.51 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius: 0.523 (+0.023/−0.021) solar radii at 695700 km per solar radius, from Torres et al. 2015 (ApJ 800, 99 (2015); arXiv:1501.01101). GM from their stellar mass 0.544 solar masses times the JPL solar GM 132712440041.93938 km^3/s^2. presentationUp: no spin axis is measured, so the display axis (celestial north at the star) is up.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius in the shared neutral gray; no picture of the photosphere is cast.
